scenarios.name: rfc_current_source_projection_has_single_authority
prove: accepted Enhanced RFC fields populate rfc_current_source_projection without duplicating source history on rfcs
external source creation chronology remains distinct from SOMA created_at
missing/unknown optional fields preserve prior accepted current facts
WFM provisional status cannot override accepted Enhanced RFC status
status_class is derived from the versioned source vocabulary rather than independently edited

scenarios.name: terminal_acceptance_atomically_creates_pending_cascade_only
prove: accepted nonterminal->Closed or Cancelled transition allocates a terminal epoch
current projection and exactly one pending cascade proposal/member set commit atomically
no Task/Objective/Communication consequence executes during source acceptance
crash/failure cannot leave terminal projection committed without its required pending proposal

scenarios.name: terminal_cascade_scope_respects_hierarchy
prove: terminal subordinate captures only that RFC plus applicable owned active WFMs
terminal root/master captures root plus exact direct subordinates and their applicable owned active WFMs
Local Tasks are not captured merely because they reference an RFC
SRs are never cascade members

scenarios.name: terminal_cascade_persists_and_stales_safely
prove: pending proposal survives restart unchanged
hierarchy/revision/applicable-WFM change after capture makes preview/execute stale
stale execution mutates nothing
explicit refresh supersedes old pending evidence and inserts a new exact pending scope without downstream consequence

scenarios.name: terminal_cascade_deliberate_atomic_execution
prove: client boolean/timestamp cannot substitute for session-bound deliberate-action proof
proof is bound to proposal ID/revision/fingerprint
LLD-05 and LLD-09 apply within the same UnitOfWork
failure/INDETERMINATE from either participant rolls back all participant changes and leaves proposal pending
successful execution preserves provider WFM facts and marks proposal executed exactly once

scenarios.name: terminal_reversal_preserves_prior_consequences
prove: terminal->recognized nonterminal current projection requires exact high-risk review
accepted reversal clears current terminal epoch and supersedes still-pending proposal
previous terminal evidence/proposal history remains immutable
already executed cascade is not undone or used to resurrect prior WFM attempts
later genuine WFM work requires its own new Task identity

scenarios.name: archive_operation_records_only_actual_changes
prove: reviewed branch scope is exact root/direct-child membership with revisions
already archived member is displayed but excluded from committed operation membership
only active->archived members get membership and archive events
archive changes no source status/hierarchy/SR/WFM/Objective/Communication state

scenarios.name: archive_restore_is_operation_scoped
prove: restore by archive_operation_id affects only members originally archived by that operation
member independently restored later is not changed again
member independently rearchived by a newer operation is not activated by the older restore
members that were already archived before the original operation can never be activated by restoring that operation

scenarios.name: rfc_hard_delete_is_narrow_audited_and_fail_closed
prove: pure untouched manual/local-provisional RFC with only permitted creation evidence can receive eligible preview
accepted source/provisional provider evidence or any hierarchy/SR/Device/Note/WFM/Task/Objective/Communication/Inventory/archive/correction history blocks eligibility
INDETERMINATE dependency blocks eligibility
commit requires unchanged revision/provider freshness/fingerprint and explicit confirmation
minimal deletion audit survives successful RFC deletion
unexpected FK dependency rolls back delete/receipt/audit
no unlink/cascade/dependent deletion is used to manufacture eligibility

scenarios.name: terminal_status_repeat_and_terminal_correction_do_not_duplicate_epoch
prove: newer repeated accepted terminal status does not create a second terminal epoch or duplicate cascade solely because chronology advanced
terminal Closed<->Cancelled correction preserves the current epoch unless a separately accepted nonterminal reversal occurred
pending/executed proposal history remains tied to the epoch that caused local consequences

scenarios.name: implement_eligibility_is_projection_not_task_authority
prove: RFC status classification can expose pre_implement vs implement_eligible to LLD-04/05
LLD-03 does not create/activate WFM work from that classification
accepted Enhanced pre-Implement evidence cannot be overridden by WFM provisional status
unknown RFC status remains explicit and does not fabricate Implement eligibility
